question: How many oblations should the best practitioner offer and with what?
premises: The best practitioner is the agent of the oblation.
Thousands of offerings are to be made.
The offerings are smeared with milk.
inference: The best practitioner should offer thousands of milk-smeared oblations.
uncertainties: The exact substance counted in thousands is implied by context.
plain_english: The best practitioner should offer thousands of oblations smeared with milk.
